leadText: Yūko Kobayashi (Japanese: 小林優子 Kobayashi Yūko) is a Japanese voice actress for . She has worked for the since the first episode. Her most significant role is that of Shigeru Okido (Gary Oak). She was born on February 6, 1961 in , .
